common_premise: Fixed R; required globals, registered species/stat metadata, parent sprites and native objects valid unless a particular guard excludes them. Source files personally actually read in full. Calls and property writes are static requests, not proof of pixels, frame timing, native resource success or completed battle/save. Settings declarations captured at source loading are distinguished from reads within update/callback. Native execution NOT_EXECUTED.

facts.meaning: ANIMATE_REFLECTIONS is read each visible update. When true and map metadata is absent or still_reflections false, horizontal zoom gets parent_zoom*0.05*sin(2*pi*System.uptime). A still-reflection map or false setting suppresses this added wobble only. Base zoom still copies parent; elapsed source is uptime, not play_time or calendar.
facts.control: Disposed returns; invisible parent disposes existing reflection then returns. No visible-update sinusoidal read follows either early return.
facts.failure_prefix: Lazy Sprite creation and position/zoom assignments precede metadata/sine and later color/bitmap/rect writes. Native/math/metadata errors may leave an allocated partially assigned sprite; there is no method rescue or rollback.
facts.open: Native sine/timing, tilemap parent render and all actual pixel results remain unobserved.

facts.meaning: TIME_SHADING affects underlying reflection visibility only when effective height>0: visible=!TIME_SHADING after dark-color/full-parent-opacity assignment. Effective height is fixed reflection(number) for named nonplayer event or current bridge height otherwise. Height<=0 uses pale color,3/4 parent opacity and visibletrue independently. Bitmap/tone/rect derive from parent, not a new time-tone computation.
facts.control: Default TIME_SHADINGtrue hides raised reflection locally; settingfalse permits it. Zero-height reflection is not hidden by this branch. The wrapper @visible reader is separate from underlying sprite.visible assigned in update.
facts.failure_prefix: Earlier geometry/bitmap/tone may already be written; last src_rect write occurs after visibility. No ensure restores prior native properties on failure.
facts.open: No unconditional on-screen visibility or all reflection consumers approved.

facts.meaning: SCREEN_WIDTH/HEIGHT are read once when the class body constructs shared viewport2 at(0,0,width,height), thenz200. Instance construction supplies that viewport to100 picture sprites; player/followers/weather use Spriteset_Map.viewport instead. Constructor creates timer and callsupdate. Global update adjusts weather/offsets and updates pictures/timer but does not reread the two Settings dimensions or resize viewport2.
facts.control: Runtime Settings reassignment is not itself a viewport2 resize. This use is distinct from Map viewport1's later live Graphics dimensions.
facts.failure_prefix: Class-body viewport creation can fail before z assignment or later definitions; instance construction/update and sequential dispose can leave prefixes. This class's dispose does not explicitly dispose shared viewport2.
facts.open: Native Viewport allocation, all Sprite_Picture internals, graphics display size and resource teardown are not execution-validated.

facts.meaning: SCREEN_WIDTH/HEIGHT are each read at class-definition time for shared viewport0 panorama z-100, viewport1 map/events/player/fog z0, viewport3 flashingz500. Constructor adds tilesets/autotiles, constructs planes/event sprites, triggers new-spriteset event and callsupdate. Each update resets only viewport1.rect to live Graphics.width/height, zeroes offsets then applies shake, updates planes/characters, assigns viewport1 tone andviewport3 flashcolor, then updates viewport1/3. It does not reread Settings dimensions or resize viewport0/3 here.
facts.control: Initial Settings512x384 are declarations, not universal live native dimensions. Settings changes alone do not retroactively reconstruct the three shared viewports. ClippableSprite's unused comment is source-local, not proof of global no-caller absence.
facts.failure_prefix: Viewport/class or tileset/plane/sprite construction may fail after earlier allocations. Panorama/fog cache names change before resource load; later errors can preserve cache/resource prefixes. dispose sequentially releases resources, with Scene_Map guard only around renderer removals.
facts.open: Full graphics renderer/AnimatedPlane/resource caller graph and native frame success remain OPEN.

facts.complete_unit: EncounterModifiers make_shiny_switch registration9–13; Pokemon attr_writer shiny28 and shiny?390–400
facts.meaning: Creation-event handler reads Game_Switches at Settings.SHINY_WILD_POKEMON_SWITCH, fixed ID31. Truthy switch directly writes Pokemon @shiny=true through attr_writer. Numeric31 is an ID, not an always-enabled Boolean. Initial absent Game_Switches lookupfalse skips write; loaded/player-set true enables it. shiny? returns cachedtrue and does not recompute PID xor until cache nil.
facts.control: False switch leaves prior shininess state intact; it does not forcefalse. This handler does not assign super_shiny or PID. Prior shiny retries from pbGenerate occur before the creation-event request.
facts.failure_prefix: Switch lookup or receiver failure can stop event traversal; earlier generated held item/PID/Pokerus/nature/form state is not rolled back by the event mechanism. No file save here.
facts.open: Later plugin handlers may modify fields; full subscriber census and native generated/save roundtrip remain separate.

facts.complete_unit: EncounterModifiers some_perfect_ivs registration34–45; Stat whole119; Pokemon calc_stats1099–1127 already own complete
facts.meaning: LEGENDARIES_HAVE_SOME_PERFECT_IVS is read when this creation callback runs. False skips before Species lookup. True requires at least one literal flag Legendary/Mythical/UltraBeast, gathers each_main Stat IDs, samples3 and writes raw IV_STAT_LIMIT31 to selected IV entries, then calc_stats. Fixed normal Stat registry has6 main stats. This is local3-stat assignment, not a whole-graph perpetual invariant.
facts.control: Unflagged Species skips; flag names are exact and independent of names/labels. Existing perfect IVs are not excluded from sample, so selected set can overlap them.
facts.failure_prefix: Raw IV writes occur sequentially before calc_stats; an exception can leave partly changed IVs and stale derived stats. No transaction, file write or rollback.
facts.open: All referenced Species flags/PBS corpus, host sample distribution and every subsequent callback remain unreceived outside actual named scope.

facts.meaning: Only Safari or BugContest context enters. Up to4 iterations break whenever any IV already equals31; otherwise set rerolledtrue and overwrite each main raw IV withrand32. calc_stats runs once afterwards iff at least one reroll happened. It need not produce a perfect IV after all4 attempts and need not reroll all4 times.
facts.control: Any preexisting perfect IV causes immediatebreak without recalc by this handler. Both contextsfalse skips.
facts.failure_prefix: A partial stat loop or later calc failure preserves earlier IV writes; earlier creation handlers are not rolled back.
facts.open: Native draws, session state correctness, all callbacks and native battle remain conditional/unexecuted.

facts.meaning: ScaleWildEncounterLevels metadata flag gates balanced-party-level minus4+rand5, clamped1..GrowthRate.max_level. Callback writes level, recalculatesstats, then resets moves. It does not request evolution or preserve custom moves by this body. Commented trainer-load example is inactive registration text.
facts.control: Missing metadata or missingflag skips via safe navigation. Exact balanced-level helper and actual party remain independent prerequisites.
facts.failure_prefix: Level can be assigned before calc failure, and stats before move-reset failure; previous object state is not restored. No durable save or scene cancellation.
facts.open: Complete balanced-level algorithm and all referenced Species move lists remain separate; this body does not grant those successors.
